scripts.diagrams: mmdc -i diagrams/skill-routing.mmd -o assets/skill-routing.svg -b transparent -w 1600 && mmdc -i diagrams/connector-execution.mmd -o assets/connector-execution.svg -b transparent -w 1600 && mmdc -i diagrams/plugin-lifecycle.mmd -o assets/plugin-lifecycle.svg -b transparent -w 1600
scripts.slides:pdf: npm run diagrams && npm run slides:pdf:day1 && npm run slides:pdf:day2 && npm run slides:pdf:day3
scripts.slides:pdf:day1: npm run slides:prepare && marp slides/day-1-skills.md --pdf --theme-set themes/claude-course.css --allow-local-files -o dist/day-1-skills.pdf
scripts.slides:pdf:day2: npm run slides:prepare && marp slides/day-2-connectors.md --pdf --theme-set themes/claude-course.css --allow-local-files -o dist/day-2-connectors.pdf
scripts.slides:pdf:day3: npm run slides:prepare && marp slides/day-3-plugins.md --pdf --theme-set themes/claude-course.css --allow-local-files -o dist/day-3-plugins.pdf
